name: AXM Diagnostics & Operations Center
actions: inspect an isolated Workshop health snapshot
see which diagnostic probes are degraded or unavailable
review a fixed catalog of bounded redacted log sources
export a diagnostic report with persistent digest lineage
summary: Observe Workshop health through independently contained probes, truthful partial coverage, bounded redacted log envelopes, and persistent diagnostic export lineage.
notes: Diagnostics remains observational. A degraded probe does not blind other probes; redaction is best effort and explicitly not secret-free certification; export is explicit and never automatic; health is evidence, not repair authority or promotion approval.
